name: Except
formula: =LAMBDA(list1,list2,FILTER(list1,ISNA(XMATCH(list1,list2)),"All Items in list1 exists in list2"))
comment: Returns items of list1 that are absent from list2, in list1 order. Arguments: list1, list2. Match is exact and case-insensitive. If none remain, returns All Items in list1 exists in list2. An error in list1 is returned. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
